effect_parameters.name: Big Knob
effect_parameters.notes: The big knob sets the output level, sometimes known as Volume. PLEASE BE CAREFUL , the Acapulco Gold is extremely loud!

effect_parameters.name: Elsewhere in your book of magic
effect_parameters.notes: “Drag,” which separates the individual digital delay lines, literally dragging them through the very fabric of time and space towards an unknown event horizon from which they may never return. Clockwise “Drag” positions will gather the delay lines close together for a more reverb-like effect. Turn the “Drag” counterclockwise, and the delay lines will begin to pull apart for a scattered ping-pong delay effect.

effect_parameters.name: Preset
effect_parameters.notes: 8 position rotary switch to recall presets. Astral Destiny ships with 8 presets which can be edited or overwritten.

effect_parameters.name: Length
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the length of the reverb decay.

effect_parameters.name: Mode
effect_parameters.notes: 8 position rotary switch to select the reverb mode.

effect_parameters.name: Depth
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the intensity of the chorus effect.

effect_parameters.name: Rate
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the rate of the chorus effect.

effect_parameters.name: Tone
effect_parameters.notes: Boosts treble clockwise, cuts treble counterclockwise. Center is a flat frequency response.

effect_parameters.name: Mix
effect_parameters.notes: Level control for the reverb effect.

effect_parameters.name: Activate Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: You are probably gonna need this to activate and deactivate the reverb effect.

effect_parameters.name: Stretch Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Doubles the length of the reverb effect while adding a temporary change in pitch.

effect_parameters.name: Time
effect_parameters.notes: This controls the delay time and goes from 0ms to just under 2000ms.

effect_parameters.name: Repeats
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the regeneration of the delay, from zero repeats to near infinite.

effect_parameters.name: Tone
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the tone for the delay line only. Roll off highs to the left, roll off lows to the right and get a flat response in the middle.

effect_parameters.name: Mix
effect_parameters.notes: The is the volume control for the delay line. This blends in the wet with dry until 1 o’clock, 1 o’clock to 3 o’clock boosts the wet signal over the dry and 3 o’clock up brings down dry until it is fully wet when all the way up.

effect_parameters.name: Expression Jack Assign Switch
effect_parameters.notes: Use this switch to map the expression jack to one of the assigned controls.

effect_parameters.name: Decay
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the reverb decay length

effect_parameters.name: R Mix
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the reverb mix

effect_parameters.name: D Mix
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the delay mix

effect_parameters.name: Ratio Selector Switch
effect_parameters.notes: Selects delay subdivisions when time is set by the “Tap” switch.

effect_parameters.name: Normal
effect_parameters.notes: This is the “standard” delay and reverb mode

effect_parameters.name: Reverse
effect_parameters.notes: This is reverse delay mode with “standard” reverb

effect_parameters.name: Swell
effect_parameters.notes: This is the volume swell mode

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the output volume of Barrows. Unity gain sits around noon, but you’ll find plenty of volume boost available when you need to push your amplifier into blissful submission.

effect_parameters.name: Attack
effect_parameters.notes: This is where the magic happens. At lower settings, Barrows provides singing, amp-like distortion with superb touch sensitivity. As you rotate clockwise, the circuit transforms into an increasingly aggressive fuzz monster, building to crushing, sustain-drenched tones that seem to go on forever. The wide range of this control means you can find everything from gentle breakup to full-on sonic annihilation.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the output level by setting the bias voltage of the transistor. A small amount of noise while dialing this in is perfectly normal.

effect_parameters.name: Drive
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the input gain of the device for different levels of dirt. You’ll find that it is thinner and more clean counterclockwise and thicker with more growl clockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Master volume

effect_parameters.name: Filter
effect_parameters.notes: Tone control more highs clockwise, more warmth counterclockwise

effect_parameters.name: Base
effect_parameters.notes: Squared input signal level

effect_parameters.name: Sub
effect_parameters.notes: Two octaves down level

effect_parameters.name: Down 1
effect_parameters.notes: One octave down level

effect_parameters.name: Up 1
effect_parameters.notes: One octave up level

effect_parameters.name: Gain
effect_parameters.notes: This controls the amount of drive.

effect_parameters.name: Tone
effect_parameters.notes: More bass to the left, more middles in the middle and more treble to the right.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: This controls the output volume.

effect_parameters.name: Symmetrical LED clipping
effect_parameters.notes: more crunch and compression.

effect_parameters.name: No clipping
effect_parameters.notes: wide open OpAmp drive for clean boost.

effect_parameters.name: Asymmetrical silicon diode clipping
effect_parameters.notes: more transparency with a loose feel.

effect_parameters.name: Sustain
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the amount of distortion and sustain.

effect_parameters.name: Tone
effect_parameters.notes: Use this to fine tune the frequency response. Boost treble by turning clockwise, boost bass and tame the top end by turning counterclockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Tone On/Off
effect_parameters.notes: This switch bypasses the tone control and delivers a more mid focused response.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the output volume.

effect_parameters.name: Speed
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the speed of the modulation. The Speed operates in three ranges (Slow/Fast/Medium) selected by the Mod Speed toggle switch. The Disaster Transport uses a Ramp wave for the modulation. You’ll find this to be much more intense than most modulated delays. Think of it as a traditional Triangle wave that falls off a cliff in mid-cycle, creating a drastic pitch bend in its wake. Or don’t and just think about whatever you want.

effect_parameters.name: Intensity
effect_parameters.notes: Controls how much the LFO modulates the delay time. More subtle chorus type effects are achieved with less intensity and more intensity will yield wild pitch stretching and bending. The overall modulation style can be made more or less subtle by using the Mod Mode toggle switch to select Bend or Stretch .

effect_parameters.name: Mix
effect_parameters.notes: Sets the volume level for the delay signal. Hear more of what you just played 30-600ms ago by turning this up.

effect_parameters.name: Repeats
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the intensity of delay feedback from no repeats at zero to self-oscillation at max. Let the past pile up on you until it implodes.

effect_parameters.name: Time
effect_parameters.notes: Sets the delay time from around 30ms at zero to 600ms* at max. Everyone needs more time; all we can offer you is about 600ms worth.

effect_parameters.name: Mod Speed
effect_parameters.notes: Three position toggle switch that sets the range in which the Speed operates.

effect_parameters.name: Mod Mode
effect_parameters.notes: Two position toggle switch to choose the modulation style. Bend is more of a traditional chorus type modulation and Stretch is a wilder pitch stretching modulation.

effect_parameters.name: Modulate
effect_parameters.notes: This foot-operated switch features Flexi-Switch® Technology and turns the modulation on and off.

effect_parameters.name: Activate
effect_parameters.notes: This foot-operated switch features Flexi-Switch® Technology and turns the effect on and off.

effect_parameters.name: actual delay time
effect_parameters.notes: influenced by several factors, with one of the most significant being the Modulation setting. If the Modulation is active, the delay time will automatically be shorter due to the parameters that determine the delay. The specified approximate delay time of 600 ms is based on the Modulation being set to off.

effect_parameters.name: Mix
effect_parameters.notes: a wet/dry blend that adjusts the overall level of the affected signal.

effect_parameters.name: Time
effect_parameters.notes: the delay time from 0ms to 1500ms (1.5 seconds).

effect_parameters.name: Reverb
effect_parameters.notes: the amount of reverb. Counterclockwise is less reverb, clockwise is more reverb.

effect_parameters.name: Repeats
effect_parameters.notes: the regeneration of the delay signal. When the Repeats control is set to maximum, you’ll get infinite repeats without runaway self-oscillation, which makes it great for creating drones, dialing in the ultimate post-rock guitar sound without feedback, or just having fun.

effect_parameters.name: Turn the Time and Repeats
effect_parameters.notes: all the way down

effect_parameters.name: Adjust the Reverb and Mix
effect_parameters.notes: to taste

effect_parameters.name: THIS
effect_parameters.notes: IMPORTANT! In Reverb-only mode, the Repeats control has a secondary function. It can be used to adjust the decay, depth, and tonal quality of the reverb! Turn it up for more dynamics and a thicker tone.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the output level. Be careful, it can get loud!

effect_parameters.name: Phase
effect_parameters.notes: Use this to select the output phase of the channel. Sometimes other pedals and various instruments will invert the phase of the signal which causes major problems when mixing with other non-inverted signals. If you have a signal that is inverted, flip the phase switch to “–” and the polarity will be corrected. In most cases this switch should stay in the “+” position.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the output volume of the channel.

effect_parameters.name: Fuzz
effect_parameters.notes: Turning this control clockwise creates more dirt.

effect_parameters.name: Tone
effect_parameters.notes: Darker and scooped tones clockwise. Brighter and more open tones counter-clockwise

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the output volume.

effect_parameters.name: Voice
effect_parameters.notes: Three way toggle switch which selects the clipping style:

effect_parameters.name: Mode 1
effect_parameters.notes: Germanium clipping. This produces a more open and looser fuzz.

effect_parameters.name: Mode 2
effect_parameters.notes: Silicon clipping. This produces a tigher, more compressed fuzz.

effect_parameters.name: Mode 3
effect_parameters.notes: Open, pure transistor drive. This produces a nearly clean octave-up effect and creates a sound very similar to ring modulation.

effect_parameters.name: Go
effect_parameters.notes: Gain control for the overdrive. Turn this up to increase the opamp gain to a thick and full distortion, or turn it down and turn up That’s It to use it as a clean boost.

effect_parameters.name: That’s It
effect_parameters.notes: Master volume for the overdrive side.

effect_parameters.name: Left Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Overdrive

effect_parameters.name: Oosh
effect_parameters.notes: Master volume for the fuzz side.

effect_parameters.name: Right Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Fuzz

effect_parameters.name: Attack
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the length of the pre-delay, from 30ms at minimum to about 150ms at maximum. When the Dwell is set to self-oscillate, this will change the pitch of the oscillations.

effect_parameters.name: Dwell
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the length of the decay. This will start to self oscillate around 3 O’clock, the pitch of the oscillations can be changed by turning the Attack control.

effect_parameters.name: Depth
effect_parameters.notes: Mixes in the wet signal with the dry, unity is around noon and everything after is boosted.

effect_parameters.name: Sweep
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the frequency peak of the sweep. Higher peak clockwise, lower peak counter clockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Rate
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the speed of the LFO. Faster clockwise, slower counterclockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Depth
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the amount of phase effect mixed with dry signal. Clockwise for more intense phasing, counterclockwise for less. In “Vibrato” mode, this acts as a volume control.

effect_parameters.name: Phase/Vibrato
effect_parameters.notes: Cuts the dry signal to create a vibe/vibrato effect depending on the setting of the other controls. Vibrato is created by turning the resonance down low.

effect_parameters.name: Resonance
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the regeneration of the phased signal. More resonant clockwise, more subtle counterclockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Volume
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the output volume. Unity is around 9-10 o’clock.

effect_parameters.name: Sustain
effect_parameters.notes: More distortion and sustain clockwise; less counterclockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Tone
effect_parameters.notes: Boost bass frequencies clockwise and boost highs counterclockwise. This control has a massive effect on the character of the Hizumitas.

effect_parameters.name: Shift
effect_parameters.notes: This adjusts the mid content, clockwise for scooped mids, counterclockwise for boosted.

effect_parameters.name: Tone
effect_parameters.notes: Bass to the left, Treble to the right.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Use this control to make the Hoof louder or quieter.

effect_parameters.name: Fuzz
effect_parameters.notes: Clockwise for heavy, counterclockwise for light.

effect_parameters.name: Depth
effect_parameters.notes: This adjusts how much the oscillator affects the signal. All the way clockwise produces a full chop, all the way counterclockwise produces no chop and the Hummingbird can be used as a simple JFET booster.

effect_parameters.name: Mode
effect_parameters.notes: Three way toggle switch which selects the range of the oscillator. Mode 1 is slow, Mode 2 is mid tempo and Mode 3 is fast.

effect_parameters.name: Rate
effect_parameters.notes: This adjusts the speed of the oscillator. Faster clockwise, slower counterclockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the output volume.

effect_parameters.name: Expression Jack
effect_parameters.notes: Use an expression pedal to adjust the rate with your foot! When an expression pedal is in use the Rate control is defeated. We recommend the Moog EP-2 expression pedal.

effect_parameters.name: Length
effect_parameters.notes: Sets the length of the reverb.

effect_parameters.name: Mix
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the level of the reverb.

effect_parameters.name: Damping
effect_parameters.notes: Tames the treble in the reverb reflections.

effect_parameters.name: Presets
effect_parameters.notes: Ledges has six available preset slots for you to save and recall your favorite settings. The settings for each of the three controls, the mode switch and the expression jack assignment can be saved and recalled in any of the slots.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: This controls the output volume.

effect_parameters.name: Gain
effect_parameters.notes: This controls the amount of drive.

effect_parameters.name: Tone
effect_parameters.notes: More bass to the left, more middles in the middle and more treble to the right.

effect_parameters.name: Symmetrical LED clipping
effect_parameters.notes: More Crunch and Compression.

effect_parameters.name: No clipping
effect_parameters.notes: Wide open OpAmp drive for clean boost.

effect_parameters.name: Asymmetrical silicon diode clipping
effect_parameters.notes: More transparency with a loose feel.

effect_parameters.name: Rate & Tap Toggle Switch
effect_parameters.notes: “Normal” (center position) is 1:1. The tempo you tap in is the tempo Pyramids will spit out. When set to “Slow” (left position), the tempo you tap is divided for a slower sweep. When set to “Fast” (right position), the tempo you tap is multiplied and delivers a faster sweep.

effect_parameters.name: Modify
effect_parameters.notes: The behavior of this control depends upon which mode you’re using.

effect_parameters.name: Tap / Trigger Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: In Classic, Through-Zero, Barber Pole Up, Barber Pole Down, Step, and Random modes, this footswitch is a tap tempo control. In Trigger Up and Trigger Down modes, this footswitch triggers the effect whenever it is pressed.

effect_parameters.name: Presets Rotary Switch
effect_parameters.notes: Selects between Live mode and one of five presets. Pyramids comes with our favorites programmed in, but you’re allowed to re-write them if you want. We don’t mind.

effect_parameters.name: Mode Rotary Switch
effect_parameters.notes: Selects between Pyramids’ eight flanger modes.

effect_parameters.name: Rainbow Machine
effect_parameters.notes: built around a DSP pitch warping engine that’s designed to be slightly imperfect; colored with digital remnants of the cosmic dust we’ve picked up across the multiverse. That is to say it’s a cold digital beast made to pretend it has feelings.

effect_parameters.name: Pitch
effect_parameters.notes: the frequency of the polyphonic pitch-warped harmony from a fourth below your input, to a third above, and every atonal pitch in-between. Noon is the unison position. Pitch may also be controlled via expression pedal. Use the Primary (4) function control to adjust the volume of the polyphonic harmony.

effect_parameters.name: Tracking
effect_parameters.notes: the lag time between the wet and dry signals. Tone (6) rolls off some treble for a darker, “vintage” sound. Clockwise Tone settings are bright, counterclockwise is dark.

effect_parameters.name: Animate
effect_parameters.notes: How far the pitch shifted signal swings, lower levels equal a tighter and more focused shift à la traditional chorus. As you increase the control a more wild and animated pitch shift begins to emerge.

effect_parameters.name: Dimension
effect_parameters.notes: Adds a slight slap-back at low levels, reverb-like ambiance at mid levels and an echo-resonance that will lead to self-oscillation at max.

effect_parameters.name: Intensity
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts how much modulated signal is blended in with the dry signal. Unity for this control is right around noon, everything above that is boosting the modulated signal.

effect_parameters.name: Depth
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts how strongly the LFO modulates the delay time.

effect_parameters.name: Shape
effect_parameters.notes: Goes from triangle wave to square wave as you turn clockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Rate
effect_parameters.notes: This sets the speed of the LFO. The miniature LED will blink to the tempo, even in bypass mode.

effect_parameters.name: Mode Toggle
effect_parameters.notes: Toggles between Digital Delay, Analog Delay, and Tape Delay

effect_parameters.name: Time
effect_parameters.notes: This sets the delay time from 0–1 second.

effect_parameters.name: Repeats
effect_parameters.notes: This controls the regeneration of the delay signal. This mode does not self-oscillate in Digital Mode but begins to self-oscillate at 3 o’clock in Analog and Tape Modes.

effect_parameters.name: Mix
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the level of the delay signal.

effect_parameters.name: Preset
effect_parameters.notes: Six available preset slots for you to save and recall your favorite settings. The settings for each of the three controls, the Mode switch and the expression jack assignment can be saved and recalled in any of the slots.

effect_parameters.name: Mode Toggle
effect_parameters.notes: Toggles between Upward Sweep , Downward Sweep or Sample & Hold .

effect_parameters.name: Range
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the sensitivity of the envelope in Up and Down mode. In Sample & Hold mode, this controls the speed.

effect_parameters.name: Filter
effect_parameters.notes: Crossfades between high pass and low pass filters and allows you to get everything in between. High pass is fully counterclockwise, low pass is full clockwise and center is band pass. This is much more useful than a simple switch you would typically find on a multi-mode because it allows you to blend the filters for different sounds!

effect_parameters.name: Resonance
effect_parameters.notes: This is the filter feedback control, it adds more body and ring to the filter voice.

effect_parameters.name: Presets
effect_parameters.notes: Six available preset slots for you to save and recall your favorite settings! The settings for each of the three controls, the Mode switch and the expression jack assignment can be saved and recalled in any of the slots.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the output volume. Unity gain is between 10-12 o’clock depending on which diodes are selected.

effect_parameters.name: Diode Selector
effect_parameters.notes: Germanium on the left for a softer and more transparent tone and Silicon on the right for a brighter and more modern edge.

effect_parameters.name: More
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the gain. This control changes the bias of the transistor, so you may hear a little noise when adjusting. Don’t worry; this is perfectly normal. At maximum gain, the Special Cranker can achieve explosive overbiased tones depending on the output of your pickups.

effect_parameters.name: Tone
effect_parameters.notes: Rolls off highs counterclockwise and boosts highs clockwise. A flat response can be found right around 3 o’clock.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Master volume control.

effect_parameters.name: Aux
effect_parameters.notes: Volume control for the Auxiliary input. The Auxiliary input bypasses the preamp and cabinet simulator circuitry.

effect_parameters.name: Bass
effect_parameters.notes: Cut and boost frequencies up to 500 Hz.

effect_parameters.name: Middle
effect_parameters.notes: Cut and boost frequencies from 500 Hz to 2 kHz.

effect_parameters.name: Treble
effect_parameters.notes: Cut and boost frequencies from 2 kHz and up.

effect_parameters.name: Inputs
effect_parameters.notes: True stereo inputs via the left and right ¼" jacks. For mono input, use the Left input only.

effect_parameters.name: Outputs
effect_parameters.notes: Stereo ¼" TRS headphone out, Left and Right XLR outs.

effect_parameters.name: Octave
effect_parameters.notes: This blends in the analog octave as you turn it clockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Filter
effect_parameters.notes: This is a low pass filter with a frequency response from around 500 Hz to 30 kHz. Turn counterclockwise for more high-end, clockwise for less.

effect_parameters.name: Distortion
effect_parameters.notes: Turn clockwise for more distortion, counterclockwise for less. This provides about +60dB of gain.

effect_parameters.name: Magnitude
effect_parameters.notes: This is the output volume for the booster. Clockwise to blow up your amp, counterclockwise if you’re a baby. Unity is somewhere right around noon on the dial.

effect_parameters.name: OpAmp
effect_parameters.notes: No diodes to allow for full, grinding Op Amp assault at maximum volume.

effect_parameters.name: Asymm
effect_parameters.notes: Utilizes two silicon diodes and one LED in an asymmetrical clipping configuration. This delivers a slightly compressed and smooth crunch, similar to a valve amplifier.

effect_parameters.name: Symm
effect_parameters.notes: This is the stock double silicon diode configuration, which provides that classic tone you know and love.

effect_parameters.name: Amplitude
effect_parameters.notes: Output volume for the octave distortion side. Clockwise for more hearing loss, counterclockwise for a healthy life in old age.

effect_parameters.name: Magnitude Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Boost Activator

effect_parameters.name: Amplitude Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Octave Distortion Activator

effect_parameters.name: Octave EXP Jack
effect_parameters.notes: Connect any expression pedal to this input to control the analog octave blend.

effect_parameters.name: Octave
effect_parameters.notes: This blends in the analog octave as you turn it clockwise.

effect_parameters.name: Distortion

effect_parameters.notes: This is a low pass filter with a frequency response from around 500Hz to 30kHz. Turn counterclockwise for more high-end, clockwise for less.

effect_parameters.name: Amplitude

effect_parameters.name: Magnitude
effect_parameters.notes: This is the output volume for the booster. Clockwise to blow up your amp, counterclockwise if you are a baby. Unity is somewhere right around noon on the dial.

effect_parameters.name: Amplitude Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Distortion Activator

effect_parameters.name: Magnitude Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Boost Activator

effect_parameters.name: Octave Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Octave Activator. The octave does not work independently. In order to use the octave, the distortion (“Amplitude”) must be active.

effect_parameters.name: Octave EXP
effect_parameters.notes: Connect any expression pedal to this input to control the analog octave blend.

effect_parameters.name: Time
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the delay time.

effect_parameters.name: Filter
effect_parameters.notes: Arguably the most fun control on Time Shadows! On the EQD side this controls an envelope for the filter frequency and a gate for the cutoff to the input of the delay. On the DBA side this controls the filter frequency as well as the shift point of a precisely phased delay line for pole zero interpolation. In the magic middle position, this controls the mix…

effect_parameters.name: Span
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the intensity of repletion.

effect_parameters.name: Preset
effect_parameters.notes: Six available preset slots for you to save and recall your favorite settings! The settings for each of the three controls, the Mode switch and the expression jack assignment can be saved and recalled in any of the slots.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Post EQ volume control. Can boost the signal up to 5x the input. Unity is around 10 o’clock.

effect_parameters.name: Treble
effect_parameters.notes: The center position is flat and marked with a center detent in the potentiometer. All settings above this point boost the treble and all settings below cut treble.

effect_parameters.name: Bass
effect_parameters.notes: The center position is flat and marked with a center detent in the potentiometer. All settings above this point boost the bass and all settings below cut bass.

effect_parameters.name: Middle
effect_parameters.notes: The center position is flat and marked with a center detent in the potentiometer. All settings above this point boost the middle and all settings below cut middle.

effect_parameters.name: Mode
effect_parameters.notes: This is a 3-position toggle switch that changes the mode of operation.

effect_parameters.name: Length
effect_parameters.notes: Controls the length of the reverb – lower settings are shorter, higher settings are longer. This control also has a secondary function to adjust the speed of the Stretch feature.

effect_parameters.name: Mix
effect_parameters.notes: This sets the overall level of the effect, balancing the ethereal with the earthly.

effect_parameters.name: Stretch Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Stretch slows down the entire digital system of Towers. As a result, the reverb length is doubled, the spectrum of frequencies is altered and a pitch bending effect can be heard throughout the morphing process.

effect_parameters.name: Frequency
effect_parameters.notes: This controls the filter frequency and has several different functions depending on which mode is selected.

effect_parameters.name: Filter
effect_parameters.notes: Controls how much the resonant low pass filter is mixed into the reverb pathways, determining the depth of harmonic resonance.

effect_parameters.name: Preset
effect_parameters.notes: Selects which user preset to use in preset mode, allowing you to recall your favorite mystical configurations.

effect_parameters.name: Activate Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: This turns the effect on and off.

effect_parameters.name: Boost
effect_parameters.notes: Use the Boost rotary knob for volume control when the Boost is active and the tone controls are bypassed. Boost mode is very loud! Be careful when setting the Boost level, especially when using headphones or XLR out.

effect_parameters.name: Boost Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: This footswitch defeats the tone controls and delivers a full-range boost without altering the frequency response. This switch is only active when the Activate footswitch is on.

effect_parameters.name: Headphone Output
effect_parameters.notes: A TRS (Stereo) ¼” headphone jack is located on the left side. Use the Level control to adjust headphone level when the pedal is active. The headphone output works as a unity gain amplifier with cabinet simulation even when the pedal is bypassed.

effect_parameters.name: Direct Output
effect_parameters.notes: A balanced XLR output is located on the left side of the pedal.

effect_parameters.name: Ground Lift Switch
effect_parameters.notes: Press this switch on the left side of the pedal for ground lift on the XLR output.

effect_parameters.name: Cab Sim Bypass Switch
effect_parameters.notes: Press this switch on the left side of the pedal to remove the analog cabinet simulation on the XLR output.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Use the Level rotary knob to adjust the output volume when the tone controls are active.

effect_parameters.name: Bass
effect_parameters.notes: Use the Bass rotary knob to adjust the frequency range from 20 Hz to 400 Hz.

effect_parameters.name: Middle
effect_parameters.notes: Use the Middle rotary knob to adjust the frequency range from 400 Hz to 2 kHz.

effect_parameters.name: Treble
effect_parameters.notes: Use the Treble rotary knob to adjust the frequency range from 2 kHz to 20 kHz.

effect_parameters.name: Activate Footswitch
effect_parameters.notes: Use this footswitch to activate or bypass the ZEQD-Pre.

effect_parameters.name: Level
effect_parameters.notes: Adjusts the output volume.

effect_parameters.name: Weight
effect_parameters.notes: This is an input frequency control that changes the voice and saturation of the distortion. Turning Weight clockwise allows more low frequencies to pass through. This increases the gain, allows lower frequencies to clip faster and can shift the tone of the pedal from tight distortion to a loose fuzz.

effect_parameters.name: Gain
effect_parameters.notes: Turn clockwise to increase distortion. This adjusts the transistor bias. A little static sound when turning is completely normal.

effect_parameters.name: Bass
effect_parameters.notes: Passive bass control, adjusts the low frequency content between 0 and 800Hz +/- 15dB.

effect_parameters.name: Middle
effect_parameters.notes: Passive middle control, adjusts the midrange frequency content between 500Hz and 3kHz +/- 10dB.

effect_parameters.name: Treble
effect_parameters.notes: Passive treble control, adjusts the high frequency content between 1kHz and 10kHz +/-15dB.
